Zenodo REST API responses, recorded once on 2026-10-19 with the Pinakes user agent
(`pinakes/0.1.0 (+https://pubky.app; info@synonym.to)`), about one request every 1.5 seconds
(guests may make 133 requests a minute). Parser regression fixtures for
`pinakes_core::sources::zenodo`; test runs make no requests.

`provenance.json` lists each fixture's request URL, status, content type, recording time, and the
size and SHA-256 of the body as served; the concept redirect (302) also carries its `Location`.
Zenodo's metadata is released under CC0; each record's files and text are under the licence the
record states (`metadata.license`).
